#### `ariaDescribedBy`

aria-describedby attribute
- Applied to the field note or error note for A11y

#### `autoComplete`

Autocomplete property
- Specifies whether an input element should have autocomplete enabled

#### `errorNote`

Error message
- An error field note that displays below the input

#### `fieldId`

Id attribute
- The ID used for A11y and to associate the label with the input

#### `fieldNote`

Field note
- The helper text that displays below the input

#### `hideLabel`

Hide label?
- If true, hides the label VISUALLY. The label element stays in the DOM and
  keeps its `for` association, so screen readers still announce the field.

Before v2 this also revealed the placeholder, because the floating label
occupied the placeholder's position and the two could not both show. The
label no longer sits inside the field, so that coupling is gone: a
`placeholder` now renders whenever it is set, independently of this.

#### `isActive`

isActive
- Dynamically sets to true if the input has a value

#### `isDisabled`

Disabled attribute
- Changes the component's treatment to represent a disabled state

#### `isError`

Error state
- Changes the component's treatment to represent an error state

#### `isFocused`

Autofocus attribute
- When present, it specifies that the text area should automatically get focus when the page loads

#### `isOptional`

Optional state
- Specifies that a field is optional and adds the text 'optional' to the label

#### `isReadonly`

Readonly attribute
- Specifies that an input field is read-only

#### `isRequired`

Required attribute
- Specifies that an input field must be filled out before submitting the form

#### `label`

Label attribute
- Specifies what content to enter within the input element

#### `labelPosition`

Label position
- `top` (default) puts the label above the field.
- `inset` puts it inside the field's top padding, above the value — the v2
  replacement for the floating label. It is STATIC: unlike the old floating
  label it never moves between states, so there is no jump on focus and no
  background patch punched through the field's border.

#### `max`

Maximum value
- Specifies a maximum value for an input element

#### `maxLength`

Max length
- Specifies the maximum number of characters required in an input element

#### `maxLengthValue`

Maxlength value
- Dynamically outputs the number of characters inside the input field

#### `min`

Minimum value
- Specifies a minimum value for an input element

#### `minLength`

Min length
- Specifies the minimum number of characters required in an input element

#### `name`

Name attribute
- Specifies the name of an input element

#### `placeholder`

Placeholder attribute
- Specifies a short hint that describes the expected value of an input element

#### `type`

Type variants
- Specifies the type input element to display
- **text** renders a standar text input
- **email** renders a text input specifically for an email format
- **number** renders an input for number values only
- **password** renders an input for a password input format
- **url** renders an input for urls only
- **tel** renders an input for telephone number values only

#### `value`

Value attribute
- Specifies the value of an input element
